title: Ninemia
body:
A broken boat with oars
stretches far across the open seas,
seeking to escape.

In the heart of the wind it roams
and the wave misleads it
and wraps around it.

It washes ashore on an unknown coast,
dizzy from the saltiness.
Its timber frames are bent,
betrayed by fate.

In your deep eyes, my love, I'll find
the lost tranquility.
My homeland is all the water,
yet my Ithaca is one.

A broken boat with oars,
that has the wind as a companion
commanding its course.

It fears not going out to the open sea,
longing for home carries sacred charms
for its stronghold.

It washes ashore on an unknown coast(...)

A broken boat with oars
is now at Aeolus's mercy
and sails on.

It rises amidst the darkness,
it has changed color in its sails
and sets..
